description: Goal 1: Implement ESPN slate loader in src/swarm/morning/espnSlate.ts supporting NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, NCAAF, NCAAB with event_id normalization and scoreboard odds extraction.
verification: fetchDaySlate returns normalized games with event_id format ${league}-${id}, weatherSnapshot, and oddsSnapshot for valid and default dates.

description: Goal 2: Implement Supabase morning persistence service in src/swarm/morning/supabase.ts to query existing game_judgments, skip swarm rows, replace direct/null rows, and upsert swarm judgments.
verification: partitionSlateGames skips swarm judge_source and targets unjudged/direct rows; upsertGameJudgment writes all required columns with real workflow_id and judge_source: swarm.

description: Goal 3: Implement baseline line_snapshots insertion in src/swarm/morning/supabase.ts with deduping, market: all, is_baseline: true, and omitting game_id.
verification: insertBaselineLineSnapshots writes one row per game with odds, skips identical existing lines, and never sends game_id.

description: Goal 4: Implement final game settlement and feedback loop in src/swarm/morning/feedback.ts to grade completed games and feed outcomes into continuous feedback calibration.
verification: gradeAndRecordFinalGames detects completed games, determines win/loss against win_prob_home, and records feedback via recordProbabilityObservation for appId duelodds.

description: Goal 5: Implement POST /api/swarm/morning in src/swarm/server/app.ts integrating slate fetching, judgment execution, line snapshots, final game learning, and fail-safe error handling.
verification: POST /api/swarm/morning requires app token, executes swarm analyze with buildJudgePrompt, writes judgments and line snapshots, grades final games, and returns structured summary.

description: Goal 6: Add Render cron service definition and documentation for morning schedule execution in render.yaml, scripts/morning-cron.mjs, and README.md.
verification: render.yaml specifies cron service executing POST /api/swarm/morning with Authorization header.

description: Goal 7: Create comprehensive unit/integration test suite in src/swarm/server/morning.test.ts and verify full regression gate (lint, test, build).
verification: All morning tests pass, npm test passes 100%, npm run lint is clean, and dual production builds succeed.
